decisions.reason: Retaining the I2C 0 Ω series resistors does not change the interboard connector types, pinouts, or pin-order policy.
The source decision concerns retaining existing I2C series resistors and does not change any component sourceability or cost policy.
The battery connector series, pitch, pin functions, and mounting type are unrelated to the I2C series resistors.
The instruction to retain I2C series resistors does not affect battery connector placement, orientation, clearance, or spacing.
The source refers specifically to 0 Ω resistors on the I2C lines, not the boost-converter enable pull-down or switched 5V sensor rail.
